ceo-todo v1.0.0

- Initial release of the ceo-todo skill, based on Brian Halligan’s single-doc CEO task management system.
- Maintains one canonical markdown file as the CEO's trusted source of truth for all commitments and next-actions.
- Automates the full Getting Things Done (GTD) loop: capture, clarify, organize, reflect, engage.
- Tracks and ages items with a fixed vocabulary ([OPEN], [DONE], [STALE], [WAITING]), owner, priority, and reply-by dates when needed.
- Provides bulletproof reliability: every run is snapshot-backed and validator-gated, guaranteeing commitments are never lost, corrupted, or silently changed.
- Handles input from emails, notes, or asks; prevents accidental auto-closure of CEO-added items; archives done work without deletion.
- Ready for use whenever the user invokes common GTD or CEO to-do prompts, or references their markdown to-do doc.
